claims.quote: As a pure Mamba-based model, Falcon Mamba 7B surpasses leading open-weight models based on Transformers, such as Mistral 7B, Llama3.1 8B, and Falcon2 11B.
claims.reason: Authors state as their own key result that pure Mamba matches or beats Transformer and hybrid designs (abstract and intro). That is an ARCH claim. Evidence is only cross-model leaderboard comparisons at different sizes and training setups, not a matched with-vs-without ablation, so PARTIAL rather than YES or NO.
